'''Virtual Block 6''' is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion (Reflections IV era). These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The hub Date is '''September 2009''' for the Reflections IV core, announced with the 16 September 2009 Players Committee homepage news (Reflections IV + virtual-set realignment).<ref name="reorg2009">https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/</ref> Later Block 6 subsets: Virtual Set 6.2 Domain of Evil (7 December 2009; tournament legal 21 December 2009); Virtual Set 6.3 Mercenaries (15 March 2010).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.

'''Fifth Anthology / Original VS18 path:''' In '''June 2009''' the Players Committee previewed '''Virtual Set 18: Fifth Anthology''' (planned July 2009).<ref name="plfifth">[https://star-wars.pl/News/10466,Preview_Fifth_Anthology.html Preview Fifth Anthology], star-wars.pl, 8 June 2009</ref> No standalone [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards18.pdf VirtualCards18.pdf] is hosted. Those preview '''titles''' appear in this Block&rsquo;s Reflections IV core ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf], official text '''4 September 2009'''; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6.html cardlist]). Spot-checked gametext for '''Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force''' and '''Maneuvering Flaps & Nick Of Time''' matches the June preview. This is '''not''' a Galaxy at War-style cancel; see [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]] and [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]]. Modern [[Virtual Set 18]] (2022) is unrelated.



Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.
